title: senecio congestus subsp. tonsus
intro: Senecio congestus subsp. tonsus, commonly known as Jacob's ladder, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat various health conditions such as fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Jacob's ladder plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
